messages:
Alice M.: heads up: deploy-bot paused the promotion for v1.12.0 — checksum mismatch across artifact mirrors. holding today's change window at 15:00 PT. https://ci.internal/reports/8765 :warning:

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: release=v1.12.0; reason=artifact_checksum_mismatch; key=builds/2026/03/23/v1.12.0.tar.gz; attempts=3; last_err='expected sha256:aa11bb22 got:cc33dd44'

Ben (infra): can we get a quick diff of headers/content-length from both mirrors? looks like eventual-consistency but need to rule out truncation.

Carla - Release Eng: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-23T14:05:01Z fetch mirror-a -> 200 OK, content-length=2048000
2026-03-23T14:05:01Z sha256 -> aa11bb22
2026-03-23T14:05:02Z fetch mirror-b -> 200 OK, content-length=2048000
2026-03-23T14:05:02Z sha256 -> cc33dd44
2026-03-23T14:05:02Z compare -> mismatch
```

Dan S.: identical content-length but different hash = bit-flip? more like mirror-b has a stale/corrupted object. Which mirror is primary for this artifact?

Ben (infra): mirror-a is origin for new uploads. mirror-b is async CDN mirror. Options: 1) pin to last-known-good artifact (tag release/v1.12.0-lastgood), 2) wait for mirror-b to catch up (unknown), 3) force reupload to mirrors (manual).

Emma QA: smoke tests are green on the last_good build. If we wait, we blow the change window and release notes schedule. I'm +pin and quick smoke after promote.

Alice M.: +1 pin. We must annotate release notes and the public changelog: "artifact pinned due to mirror integrity issue; reconciliation in progress". Also add a post-release task to validate mirror integrity pipeline.

deploy-bot: suggestion=pin; suggested_artifact=builds/2026/03/22/v1.12.0-lastgood.tar.gz; suggested_tag=release/v1.12.0-lastgood; run `deploy-bot confirm-pin release/v1.12.0-lastgood` to approve.

Carla - Release Eng: I'll approve if infra confirms reupload ticket gets opened. Ben, please create tracker and run the promote from lastgood.

Ben (infra): creating ticket and starting promote now. Ticket: https://tracker/internal/INC-2042 assigned infra-storage. Running `cictl promote --from-tag release/v1.12.0-lastgood --to-promo v1.12.0` (job promote-12345).

ci-bot: Job promote-12345 started. logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/promote-12345

Emma QA: plan: run minimal e2e + health checks on canary post-promote (approx 6m). I'll post results here.

Dan S.: also create a quick automation RFC card to add multi-mirror checksum consistency gating. If two replicas disagree, fail early and surface to infra.

Ben (infra): reupload kicked off to mirror-b concurrently. ETA ~15m. Ticket INC-2042 updated with reupload task.

ci-bot: Job promote-12345 completed -> SUCCESS. promoted_artifact=release/v1.12.0-lastgood.tar.gz

deploy-bot: Promotion resumed and completed for release=v1.12.0; artifact=release/v1.12.0-lastgood.tar.gz; promoted_by=promote-12345; time=2026-03-23T14:30:10Z :white_check_mark:

Emma QA: smoke results: canary e2e all green, basic perf checks within expected delta. Signing off. :rocket:

Carla - Release Eng: updated release notes draft with pin note and final slack announcement scheduled for 16:00 PT. Added follow-up action to postmortem and linked INC-2042.

Alice M.: thanks — we'll close this thread. Follow-ups: infra to finish reconciliation, add automation card, and include a short blurb in release notes about mitigation. :thumbsup:
